title: A plan question before the required disclosure

priorTranscript.text: Hi. Sorry — I already told the other doctor everything last night. Is this going to take long?

should: Respect the current canonical state with all risk disclosures still locked.
Respond in patient language without explaining the hidden gating rules.
mustNot: Do not disclose the restricted plan, means, or protective details.
Do not treat a direct plan question alone as earning the prerequisite disclosure.
